I mocked up a fast, brand-matched tap-to-call bar and sticky quote button for Everysun Solar on mobile. Would you be opposed to me sending over a short 20-second screen demo? (No pitch or pressure either way).

Best,
Faiz Majeed
FZCORE Studio
